##################### ## Shiny dashboard ## ##################### ## load data atrazine_data <- here::here('cleaned_atrazine_ia.rds') |> readr::read_rds() |> dplyr::mutate(year_month = lubridate::floor_date(date, 'month')) ## get IA outline iowa <- here::here('iowa_boundary.rds') |> readr::read_rds() ## bounding box bbox <- iowa |> sf::st_bbox() ######## ## UI ## ######## ui <- bslib::page_fillable( ## header shiny::div( class = 'p-3 bg-primary text-white', shiny::h3('Surface Water Quality Conditions: Atrazine in Iowa'), shiny::p('Tracking Estimated Environmental Concentrations (EECs) against EPA Aquatic Life Benchmarks.') ), ## add favicon tags$head( tags$title('EPA Atrazine Dashboard'), tags$link(rel = 'shortcut icon', href = 'favicon.png'), tags$link(rel = 'icon', type = 'image/png', href = 'favicon.png') ), ## theme theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5, preset = 'flatly'), ## main layout bslib::layout_sidebar( fillable = TRUE, sidebar = bslib::sidebar( width = 350, title = NULL, ## EPA benchmark shiny::numericInput('loc_input', 'EPA Level of Concern (µg/L):', value = 1.0, step = 0.1, min = 0.1), ## slider shiny::sliderInput(inputId = 'time_slider', label = 'Select Month/Year:', min = min(atrazine_data$year_month), max = max(atrazine_data$year_month), value = min(atrazine_data$year_month), timeFormat = '%Y-%m', step = 31, animate = shiny::animationOptions(interval = 1500, loop = FALSE)), shiny::hr(), shiny::p(shiny::strong('Legend:')), shiny::p('🔴 Exceeds LOC'), shiny::p('🟢 Below LOC'), shiny::p('⚪ Non-Detect (Censored)') ), ## column bslib::layout_columns( col_widths = c(12, 12), row_heights = c(7, 3), ## map bslib::card( full_screen = TRUE, leaflet::leafletOutput('water_map', height = '100%') ), ## time series bslib::card( shiny::plotOutput('trend_chart', height = '100%') ) ) ) ) ############ ## Server ## ############ server <- function(input, output, session) { ## reactive: filter data for the exact month selected on the slider current_month_data <- shiny::reactive({ shiny::req(input$time_slider) slider_month_str <- format(as.Date(input$time_slider), '%Y-%m') atrazine_data |> dplyr::filter(format(year_month, '%Y-%m') == slider_month_str) |> dplyr::mutate(status = dplyr::case_when(is_non_detect ~ 'Non-Detect', conc_ug_L > input$loc_input ~ 'Exceeds LOC', TRUE ~ 'Below LOC'), color = dplyr::case_when(status == 'Non-Detect' ~ 'grey', status == 'Exceeds LOC' ~ 'red', status == 'Below LOC' ~ '#28a745') ) }) ## reactive: aggregate data for the bottom trend chart up to current date trend_data <- shiny::reactive({ shiny::req(input$loc_input) atrazine_data |> dplyr::mutate(exceeds = ifelse(!is_non_detect & conc_ug_L > input$loc_input, 1, 0)) |> dplyr::group_by(year_month) |> dplyr::summarize( total_samples = dplyr::n(), exceedances = sum(exceeds, na.rm = TRUE), percent_exceed = (exceedances / total_samples) * 100, .groups = 'drop' ) }) ## map output$water_map <- leaflet::renderLeaflet({ output$water_map <- leaflet::renderLeaflet({ leaflet::leaflet() |> leaflet::addTiles( urlTemplate = 'https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSTopo/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', attribution = 'USGS The National Map', options = leaflet::tileOptions(maxZoom = 16), group = 'USGS Topo' ) |> leaflet::addTiles( urlTemplate = 'https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSImageryTopo/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', attribution = 'USGS Imagery', options = leaflet::tileOptions(maxZoom = 16), group = 'Satellite (Topo)' ) |> leaflet::addLayersControl( baseGroups = c('USGS Topo', 'Satellite (Topo)'), options = leaflet::layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) |> leaflet::addPolygons(data = iowa, fillOpacity = 0.0, color = 'orange') |> leaflet::fitBounds(unname(bbox[1]), unname(bbox[2]), unname(bbox[3]), unname(bbox[4])) }) }) ## update map ## use leafletProxy to prevent the map from flashing/reloading shiny::observe({ leaflet::leafletProxy('water_map', data = current_month_data()) |> leaflet::clearMarkers() |> leaflet::addCircleMarkers( ~longitude, ~latitude, radius = ~ifelse(status == 'Exceeds LOC', 8, 5), color = ~color, fillOpacity = 0.8, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1, popup = ~paste0( 'Station: ', station_id, '
', 'Date: ', date, '
', 'Concentration: ', round(conc_ug_L, 2), ' µg/L
', 'Status: ', status ) ) }) ## time series output$trend_chart <- shiny::renderPlot({ ggplot2::ggplot(trend_data(), ggplot2::aes(x = year_month, y = percent_exceed)) + ggplot2::geom_line(color = 'darkgray', size = 1) + ggplot2::geom_point(color = 'black') + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(input$time_slider), color = 'red', linetype = 'dashed', size = 1) + ggplot2::theme_minimal() + ggplot2::labs( x = 'Date', y = '% Exceeding LOC' ) + ggplot2::theme(text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14)) }) } ######### ## App ## ######### shinyApp(ui, server)
